title: Pasig City Walking Guide: Food, Culture & Local Experience (2026)
introduction: Pasig is not a tourist city—but that’s its advantage. This guide helps you explore real local life through walking and food experiences.

sections.heading: Walking Strategy
sections.content: Plan short loops, start early, and use cafés as rest stops due to heat.
